behavior: Default bootstrap output shows flushed installation stages and readable completion/current result.
Shows installed version, executable path and usable next commands.
When command directory is missing from PATH, shows quoted full command and Unix PATH setup.
--json suppresses human progress and retains the result dictionary.
CLI update and direct install() callers retain their JSON/dictionary contract.
PowerShell scopes UTF-8 to installer I/O and restores prior process encodings.
